checks.name: CK_meta_row_disposition_shape
checks.definition: ([outcome]='REJECTED' AND [primary_reason]<>'NONE' AND [trip_key] IS NULL AND [representative_source_row_id] IS NULL OR [outcome]='ACCEPTED' AND [primary_reason]='NONE' AND [trip_key] IS NOT NULL AND [representative_source_row_id] IS NOT NULL AND [representative_source_row_id]=[source_row_id] OR [outcome]='DUPLICATE_EXACT' AND [primary_reason]='NONE' AND [trip_key] IS NOT NULL AND [representative_source_row_id] IS NOT NULL AND [representative_source_row_id]<>[source_row_id])

checks.name: CK_meta_load_run_status
checks.definition: (([status]='FAILED' OR [status]='PUBLISHED' OR [status]='VALIDATED' OR [status]='RUNNING' OR [status]='CREATED') AND datalength([status])=len([status]))

checks.name: CK_meta_load_run_finished
checks.definition: ((NOT ([status]='FAILED' OR [status]='PUBLISHED' OR [status]='VALIDATED') OR [finished_at_utc] IS NOT NULL) AND ([finished_at_utc] IS NULL OR [finished_at_utc]>=[started_at_utc]))

checks.name: CK_meta_load_run_versions
checks.definition: ([model_version]='1.0' AND datalength([model_version])=(3) AND [metric_rule_version]='A-1.0' AND datalength([metric_rule_version])=(5) AND [processing_policy_version]='B1-1.0' AND datalength([processing_policy_version])=(6))

checks.name: CK_meta_row_disposition_reason
checks.definition: (([primary_reason]='DURATION_GT_24H' OR [primary_reason]='DURATION_LT_60S' OR [primary_reason]='NONPOSITIVE_DURATION' OR [primary_reason]='TIME_PARSE_ERROR' OR [primary_reason]='CONFLICTING_RIDE_ID' OR [primary_reason]='MISSING_RIDE_ID' OR [primary_reason]='NONE') AND datalength([primary_reason])=len([primary_reason]))

checks.name: CK_meta_coverage_proof
checks.definition: ([coverage_status]<>'complete' OR [proof_ref] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim(rtrim([proof_ref])))>(0))

checks.name: CK_dim_date_calendar
checks.definition: ([date_key]=((datepart(year,[calendar_date])*(10000)+datepart(month,[calendar_date])*(100))+datepart(day,[calendar_date])) AND [calendar_year]=datepart(year,[calendar_date]) AND [calendar_quarter]=datepart(quarter,[calendar_date]) AND [calendar_month]=datepart(month,[calendar_date]) AND [year_month]=CONVERT([char](7),[calendar_date],(126)) AND [day_of_month]=datepart(day,[calendar_date]) AND [iso_weekday]=((datediff(day,CONVERT([date],'19000101',(112)),[calendar_date])%(7)+(7))%(7)+(1)))

checks.name: CK_dim_date_weekday_name
checks.definition: ([weekday_name]=case [iso_weekday] when (1) then N'星期一' when (2) then N'星期二' when (3) then N'星期三' when (4) then N'星期四' when (5) then N'星期五' when (6) then N'星期六' when (7) then N'星期日'  end)

checks.name: CK_dim_station_unknown
checks.definition: ([station_key]=(0) AND [is_unknown]=(1) AND [station_id] IS NULL AND [station_name]=N'未知站点' AND [name_is_fallback]=(1) AND [name_source_row_id] IS NULL AND [reference_lat] IS NULL AND [reference_lng] IS NULL AND [coordinate_source_row_id] IS NULL AND [coordinate_role] IS NULL OR [station_key]>(0) AND [is_unknown]=(0) AND [station_id] IS NOT NULL AND len(replace(replace(replace(replace([station_id],nchar((9)),N''),nchar((10)),N''),nchar((13)),N''),N' ',N''))>(0))

checks.name: CK_dim_station_name_source
checks.definition: ([name_is_fallback]=(1) AND [name_source_row_id] IS NULL OR [name_is_fallback]=(0) AND [name_source_row_id] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_dim_station_coordinates
checks.definition: ([reference_lat] IS NULL AND [reference_lng] IS NULL AND [coordinate_source_row_id] IS NULL AND [coordinate_role] IS NULL OR [reference_lat] IS NOT NULL AND [reference_lng] IS NOT NULL AND [reference_lat]>=(-90) AND [reference_lat]<=(90) AND [reference_lng]>=(-180) AND [reference_lng]<=(180) AND [coordinate_source_row_id] IS NOT NULL AND [coordinate_role] IS NOT NULL AND ([coordinate_role]='end' OR [coordinate_role]='start') AND datalength([coordinate_role])=len([coordinate_role]))

checks.name: CK_dim_bike_type_unknown
checks.definition: ([bike_type_key]=(0) AND [is_unknown]=(1) AND [bike_type_code] IS NULL OR [bike_type_key]>(0) AND [is_unknown]=(0) AND [bike_type_code] IS NOT NULL AND len(replace(replace(replace(replace([bike_type_code],nchar((9)),N''),nchar((10)),N''),nchar((13)),N''),N' ',N''))>(0))

checks.name: CK_dim_member_type_unknown
checks.definition: ([member_type_key]=(0) AND [is_unknown]=(1) AND [member_type_code] IS NULL OR [member_type_key]>(0) AND [is_unknown]=(0) AND [member_type_code] IS NOT NULL AND len(replace(replace(replace(replace([member_type_code],nchar((9)),N''),nchar((10)),N''),nchar((13)),N''),N' ',N''))>(0))

checks.name: CK_dwd_fact_trip_start_coordinates
checks.definition: (([start_coordinate_status]='out_of_range' OR [start_coordinate_status]='nonnumeric' OR [start_coordinate_status]='missing' OR [start_coordinate_status]='valid') AND datalength([start_coordinate_status])=len([start_coordinate_status]) AND ([start_coordinate_status]='valid' AND [start_lat] IS NOT NULL AND [start_lng] IS NOT NULL AND [start_lat]>=(-90) AND [start_lat]<=(90) AND [start_lng]>=(-180) AND [start_lng]<=(180) OR [start_coordinate_status]<>'valid' AND [start_lat] IS NULL AND [start_lng] IS NULL))

checks.name: CK_dwd_fact_trip_end_coordinates
checks.definition: (([end_coordinate_status]='out_of_range' OR [end_coordinate_status]='nonnumeric' OR [end_coordinate_status]='missing' OR [end_coordinate_status]='valid') AND datalength([end_coordinate_status])=len([end_coordinate_status]) AND ([end_coordinate_status]='valid' AND [end_lat] IS NOT NULL AND [end_lng] IS NOT NULL AND [end_lat]>=(-90) AND [end_lat]<=(90) AND [end_lng]>=(-180) AND [end_lng]<=(180) OR [end_coordinate_status]<>'valid' AND [end_lat] IS NULL AND [end_lng] IS NULL))
